summary: The Chief Transformation Officer, will provide a presentation on the Smart Cities Challenge initiative.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the City Manager to request the Government of Ontario to designate the last Thursday in May of each year as "Provincial Digital Literacy Day" beginning on May 30, 2019 and that the appropriate Provincial Ministries work in collaboration with all interested Ontario municipalities. 2. City Council request the City Manager to incorporate a Digital Infrastructure Plan within the Smart City work.
text: The Chief Transformation Officer, will provide a presentation on the Smart Cities Challenge initiative.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the City Manager to request the Government of Ontario to designate the last Thursday in May of each year as "Provincial Digital Literacy Day" beginning on May 30, 2019 and that the appropriate Provincial Ministries work in collaboration with all interested Ontario municipalities. 2. City Council request the City Manager to incorporate a Digital Infrastructure Plan within the Smart City work.
